sources.title: COMAP 2025 MCM/ICM official problem index
sources.notes: Authoritative landing page for six 2025 problem statements and the C/D data attachments.

sources.title: COMAP 2024 MCM/ICM official problem index
sources.notes: Six 2024 MCM/ICM problem statements; use as a held-out task source after prompt and parameter development are frozen.

sources.title: COMAP 2023 MCM/ICM official problem index
sources.notes: Eight 2023 MCM/ICM problem statements; separate from training and prompt selection to test genuine unseen-task generalization.

sources.title: 2025 MCM C problem statement
sources.notes: Problem statement; use the official index for the associated data zip.

sources.title: 2025 ICM E problem statement
sources.notes: Pure-mechanism problem: useful for testing no-upload workflows.

sources.title: COMAP MCM/ICM rules and judging guidance
sources.notes: Emphasizes thought process, analysis, modeling approaches, mathematical methods, validation, sensitivity/stability, strengths and weaknesses.

sources.title: International Math Modeling Contest official guide
sources.notes: Official contest page describes independent evaluation by three mathematics/physics professors; use as rubric-process reference, not a numerical gold answer.

sources.title: SIAM GAI MM mathematical modeling rubric
sources.notes: A reusable modeling-assessment rubric; store metadata and cite the source, do not copy the PDF into the repository.

sources.title: Zenodo phase-level mathematical modeling assessment dataset
sources.notes: Anonymized classroom phase scores and codebook useful for rubric calibration; it is not a held-out contest gold standard.

sources.title: Modeling the Future Challenge official FAQ
sources.notes: The qualifying scenario includes a real-world dataset and multiple modeling/risk questions; access to active-year material is controlled by the organizer.

sources.title: Modeling the Future Challenge program page
sources.notes: Describes real-world data analysis, modeling, risk analysis and recommendations; contact the organizer for an independent evaluation partnership.

sources.title: International Mathematical Modeling Contest official page
sources.notes: Official page documents contest delivery and independent professor evaluation; request organizer permission before using an unreleased problem as a holdout.

sources.title: MathWorks Math Modeling Challenge official rules
sources.notes: Official rules document timed real-world modeling and multi-stage judging; contest eligibility and organizer permission apply to any private holdout use.

sources.title: COMAP 2025 MCM/ICM results
sources.notes: Award labels can stratify reference material, but must never become numerical correctness labels.

sources.title: UMAP Journal 46.4: 2025 MCM papers and Judges' Commentary
sources.notes: Covers MCM A, B and C; store only metadata unless access rights permit retrieval.

sources.title: UMAP Journal 46.3: 2025 ICM papers and Judges' Commentary
sources.notes: Covers ICM D, E and F; commentary is not copied into this repository.

sources.title: COMAP 2025 ICM D Better City resource page
sources.notes: Confirms that commentary and student papers exist; access is controlled by Mathmodels membership.

sources.title: MM-Agent / MM-Bench (111 MCM/ICM problems)
sources.notes: External research benchmark; do not mix its scores with sealed-corpus scores without a predeclared protocol.

sources.title: MM-Agent public implementation
sources.notes: Pin a commit and inspect its license before running or vendoring code.

sources.title: mathworks MCM/ICM archive
sources.notes: Useful for human inspection; each file's license must be checked separately.

sources.title: Public 2025 MCM C solution/code repository
sources.notes: A competing implementation, not a gold answer; use for hypothesis diversity and smoke tests only.

sources.title: Public 2025 ICM D solution/code repository
sources.notes: Reported as a Meritorious Winner repository; award status is not mathematical correctness.

sources.title: PySINDy official documentation
sources.notes: Sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics reference; use the same feature library, differentiation and validation budget when comparing equation-discovery candidates.

sources.title: PySINDy weak-form PDE identification example
sources.notes: Documents weak-form PDE identification for noisy data; this is an implementation reference, not a correctness oracle for a contest problem.

sources.title: SciML Universal Differential Equations documentation
sources.notes: Reference for hybrid mechanistic plus learned differential equations; treat neural correction terms as a competing hypothesis requiring independent stability and extrapolation checks.

sources.title: Universal Differential Equations for Scientific Machine Learning
sources.notes: Primary paper for the UDE formulation; citation metadata is retained without copying the paper or claiming its examples validate this project.

sources.title: LLM-SR official implementation
sources.notes: Official implementation of LLM-guided scientific equation discovery; pin a commit and inspect its MIT license before executing or vendoring.

sources.title: LLM-SRBench scientific equation-discovery benchmark
sources.notes: Out-of-distribution equation-discovery benchmark designed to reduce memorization; keep its task data and scores separate from sealed MCM/ICM evaluation.

sources.title: DrivenData real-world data-science competitions
sources.notes: External predictive-accuracy arm with real-world tasks and competition scoring; not an open-ended mathematical-modeling gold standard.

sources.title: DrivenData hidden-label code-execution competition design
sources.notes: Documents secure evaluation with hidden test labels; use only for a pre-registered prediction metric and keep it separate from expert-scored modeling claims.

sources.title: Kaggle competition setup and hidden ground truth
sources.notes: Platform documentation for hidden solution files and leaderboard scoring; competition-specific terms and licenses must be checked before use.

sources.title: TML-Bench tabular machine-learning agent benchmark
sources.notes: Research benchmark reporting private-holdout scores on hidden labels; useful for predictive execution accuracy, not a substitute for open-ended mathematical-modeling evaluation.

sources.title: TML-Bench code and benchmark materials
sources.notes: Repository for reproducing the tabular-agent benchmark; pin a commit and inspect task-data and model-output licenses before execution.

sources.title: UCI Airfoil Self-Noise public regression dataset
sources.notes: Used as an external public-label regression case; source bytes and hash are pinned in external_dataset_catalog.json. It is not a sealed contest rubric or expert gold standard.
